title: Nullmask / $MASK: the most underrated privacy coin of the cycle
text:
Nullmask / $MASK: the most underrated privacy coin of the cycle

$MASK is currently sitting at around $23.5m market cap ($40m FDV, with 40% of supply out of circulation and 2.16% already burnt)

i believe Nullmask is by far the most underrated privacy coin in all of crypto, and i'll explain why in this thread

let's start by looking at the top privacy coins and their market caps:

• ZCash / $ZEC: $21 BILLION market cap
• $NEAR: $6.8 BILLION market cap

these two have been by far the biggest gainers in the top 50 cryptocurrencies over the past year, and it's not even close!

if it isn't already obvious, both have run hard (and continue to run) on the PRIVACY narrative

but what's impressive isn't just their gigantic market caps

it's how much they've added in the past year alone:

• ZCash added $18 BILLION to its market cap
• NEAR added $4.3 BILLION to its market cap

all before the bull run has properly started

so how does this affect Nullmask / $MASK?

the incredible runs ZEC, NEAR, and other privacy coins have had have established beyond reasonable doubt that this is the privacy cycle

and i believe Nullmask is going to win big because it sits right at the heart of this narrative, with several key advantages that many much bigger privacy coins don't have

let's start with the PRODUCT

Nullmask makes private transactions possible across EVM chains and Solana in the most normie-friendly way imaginable

you can use your existing wallets (MetaMask, Rabby, Phantom, etc.) the same way you normally would, while enabling private transactions across major ecosystems like Ethereum, BNB, Base, Robinhood, and Solana

yes, you read that right

you don't need to learn how to use a new wallet, create a new seed phrase or private key, learn to navigate a complicated new blockchain, or deal with any of that nonsense

you can activate Nullmask's privacy capabilities on your existing crypto setup in just a few clicks

all you need to do is activate Nullmask's custom RPC and let its 'virtual private network' shield your transfers using zero-knowledge proofs

i'm simplifying the technical details to make this as normie-friendly as possible, but that's the gist of it

and this isn't just speculative stuff: Nullmask is already LIVE & WORKING on Ethereum, BNB, Base, and Robinhood

you can actually use the product and verify that it works!

but i'm bullish on $MASK for more than just the product

TOTAL ADDRESSABLE MARKET (TAM)

what makes Nullmask so incredibly bullish and underrated isn't just how impressive the product is, but the size of its total addressable market

i've never used the ZCash or NEAR blockchains, and the same is true for tens of millions of users across Solana, Robinhood, Base, BNB, and Ethereum

yet ZCash and NEAR have market caps of approximately $21 BILLION and $7 BILLION, respectively

the average crypto user may never touch the ZCash or NEAR blockchains, but they're already using Ethereum, Robinhood, BNB, Solana, and Base

and Nullmask caters to those users

this begs the question:

what is fair value for Nullmask when ZCash and NEAR are both trading at multibillion-dollar valuations?

LET'S TALK ABOUT THE TEAM

when a protocol promises something as ambitious as Nullmask does, you obviously want to know who's building it and whether they're capable of delivering

Nullmask is built by several ZCash contributors, led by Tomas Krnak

Tomas Krnak helped build shielded ZCash transactions for hardware wallets. his work was funded by the ZCash Foundation and merged into the main ZCash protocol itself

i should also add that the lead dev is doxxed and regularly participates in live interviews!

PARTNERSHIPS & INTEGRATIONS

we've established that the team has serious credentials in the privacy space and that the product is already live and working

but what about partnerships, integrations, and endorsements?

here's a list of industry players Nullmask has collaborated with in some form since launching:

• NEAR Protocol ($11.3 BILLION ATH)
• THORChain ($4.4 BILLION ATH)
• Dashpay
• Beldex
• Quai Network

the team also revealed in a recent AMA that it's in discussions with major wallet providers, including MetaMask, about potentially integrating Nullmask as an additional privacy layer

all of this for a product that isn't even a month old, by the way!

METRICS & REVENUE

Nullmask looks incredibly strong from a fundamentals perspective, but the key question is:

what do the metrics actually look like?

since the protocol launched a little over two weeks ago, Nullmask has generated:

• $37.8 MILLION in total protocol volume, averaging $2.36 million per day
• $833k in total revenue, averaging $52k per day

it has also burnt 2.16% of supply and distributed $1.4 MILLION in $ZEC rewards to holders since the token launched approximately three weeks ago (token launched a week before the protocol)

and here's the important part:

all these adoption metrics were recorded before the protocol is live on Solana, which is expected to happen next week, and mostly before it went live on Robinhood and BNB just a few days earlier

the team also has 20% of the token supply allocated to a long-term incentives campaign designed to encourage people to use the protocol and accelerate adoption

i should also add that Nullmask is now ranked #1 among ALL privacy protocols for both 7-day and 30-day revenue, according to DeFiLlama, barely two weeks after its protocol went live, and by a clear margin

this is despite the fact that 

-it only went live on Robinhood and BNB a few days earlier
- it is yet to launch on Solana
- its incentives program aimed at accelerating adoption is yet to launch

the speed of adoption Nullmask has witnessed is impressive for any privacy protocol

TOKENOMICS

20% of the token supply is allocated to the team and locked for two years, meaning these tokens won't start entering circulation until at least two years after token launch

another 20% is reserved for an incentives campaign aimed at accelerating protocol adoption

the remaining 60% of supply is circulating

this means approximately 60% of the supply is currently in circulation, while the bulk of the rest won't enter circulation anytime soon

ROADMAP

• Launch on Ethereum, Robinhood, BNB, and Base (LIVE)
• Cross-chain bridge (LIVE)
• Unshield directly to ZEC wallets (October 2026)
• Launch on Solana (Q4 2026)
• NullMask SDK (Q4 2026)
• Privacy Perpetuals (Q4 2026)

TO CONCLUDE

i know Nullmask might sound too good to be true right now, and it's crazy to me that it's sitting at such a ridiculously low market cap

but believe it or not, all of the facts in my thesis above can be independently verified

i'm not going to ask you to buy Nullmask

i'm simply laying out my thesis and thought process for this trade, and explaining why i believe it could be a big one

i objectively believe $MASK will become a multibillion-dollar token before the end of the bull run, and i expect it to be yet another kingmaker trade for me

nothing in this thesis is financial advice

it's up to you what you do with the above information

title: My biggest edge has almost always been HODLing
text:
the funny thing is that people watch someone like me go from nothing to the top of the fomo leaderboard

and assume i won because i'm some top-tier trader or had insider info

but the reality is that my biggest edge has almost always been HODLing

i often discover my biggest winners relatively late

i'm not even among the first 1,000 buyers in many cases

and some of my biggest wins have average entries well above $5m market cap

so it's not like i'm getting in super early and accumulating massive supply for next to nothing

my real edge is holding with dogged conviction while everyone else panic sells

when i find a top-tier narrative, i'm often willing to hold for much longer than everyone else, regardless of short-term price action

while most people expect a trade to play out in days or weeks, i'm willing to sit through the volatility and let the thesis play out

that's literally it

everyone is looking for the perfect entry, but sometimes the real edge is having the conviction to hold when everyone else folds

and this has consistently been rewarded

title: A major mistake: blindly loyal to bags and communities
text:
a major mistake i made in the past was being blindly loyal to my bags and the communities around them

i round-tripped eight figures while chasing social clout last cycle because of it

you'd think the people in those communities would've stood by me afterward

nah

most of them ridiculed me and clowned on me

and, honestly, rightly so

i won't be making the same mistake this cycle

vanity metrics like social clout might feel good in the moment, but they rarely last

when the tide turns, the same people will happily turn on you

your loyalty should be to YOUR

not your bags

and certainly not any community

you should be routinely taking profits on any and every coin

as long as you're not doing anything illegal or unethical

title: We get a new chain every cycle (Robinhood thesis)
text:
imagine thinking the Robinhood chain eco just dies here and that's it

you must be a beginner

those who have been here for multiple cycles and are carefully paying attention will tell you this:

we get a new chain every cycle where the main action happens

and it's rarely the same chain every cycle

in the 2020/2021 era it was Ethereum

then it was Solana in the 2022/2023 era

it will be Robinhood chain in the 2026/2027 era

i strongly suggest positoning accordingly
